stage_designation.quote: The overall design parameters for this stage which consists of rotor 55 and stator 55 (designated stage 55-55) are listed in table I.

designer.value: Hamilton Standard Division of United Aircraft Corporation (contract); 51-cm model of a 183-cm full-scale fan
designer.quote: This stage was designed and built on contract by the Hamilton Standard Division of United Aircraft Corporation. ... a full-scale (183-cm-diam.) fan stage and a 51-centimeter-diameter model

design_parameters_source.value: design blade-element parameters are those supplied by the contractor
design_parameters_source.quote: The blade-element design parameters shown are those supplied by the contractor.

design_pressure_ratio_text.quote: The fan stage was designed for a pressure ratio of 1. 20, a rotor tip speed of 213.3 meters per second, efficiency of 0. 908, and a weight flow per unit annulus area of 195. 3 kilograms per second per square meter.

design_tip_speed_text.quote: a rotor tip speed of 213.3 meters per second

design_weight_flow_summary.quote: At the design speed of 213. 3 meters per second and weight flow of 31. 2 kilograms per second (195. 3 kg/(sec)(m2) of annulus area)

annulus_area_rotor_le.quote: Aan annulus area at rotor leading edge, 0.160 m2

frontal_area_rotor_le.quote: Af frontal area at rotor leading edge, 0. 203 m2

rotor_profile.quote: The rotor utilized double-circular-arc blade profiles.

rotor_tip_solidity.quote: The rotor was designed with a tip solidity of 0. 89 and a hub-tip radius ratio of 0.46.

rotor_blade_count.quote: This resulted in 15 rotor blades with an aspect ratio of 1.43.

rotor_aspect_ratio.quote: 15 rotor blades with an aspect ratio of 1.43

rotor_adjustable.value: adjustable rotor blades (variable pitch); this report is at the design setting angle
rotor_adjustable.quote: The additional requirements for the fan stage were low noise and adjustable rotor blades.

rotor_material.quote: The 15 rotor blades were machined from a titanium alloy.

stator_profile.quote: The stator blades were designed utilizing NACA 400 Series airfoils. The constant chord stator blades had a tip solidity of 0. 712 and a hub-tip radius ratio of 0.47.

stator_tip_solidity.quote: The constant chord stator blades had a tip solidity of 0. 712

stator_blade_count.quote: This resulted in 11 stator blades with an aspect ratio of 1. 27.

stator_aspect_ratio.quote: 11 stator blades with an aspect ratio of 1. 27

stator_material_support.value: aluminum alloy; supported at hub and tip
stator_material_support.quote: The stator blades were machined from an aluminum alloy. The stators are supported at both the hub and tip.

rotor_tip_contour.value: rotor blade tips contoured to allow resetting the blades to a reverse-flow position
rotor_tip_contour.quote: The rotor blade tips were contoured to provide adequate clearance for resetting the blades to a reverse flow position to provide reverse thrust capability.

rotor_tip_clearance_centerline.quote: The nominal tip clearance at the rotor blade centerline was 0. 06 centimeter.

rotor_tip_clearance_le_te.quote: At the leading and trailing edges, the tip clearances were approximately 0.08 centimeter for the design setting angle.

part_span_damper.quote: (no damper is mentioned in the text)

survey_stations.value: 1 upstream of rotor, 2 between rotor and stator, 3 downstream of stator; 9 radial positions; axial locations only drawn in Fig. 1 (no numbers)
survey_stations.quote: Radial surveys of the flow were made upstream of the rotor, between the rotor and stator, and downstream of the stator (see fig. 1 for axial location).

data_translated_to_blade_edges.quote: The data, measured at the three measuring stations, have been translated to planes approximating the blade leading and trailing edges by the method presented in reference 3.

test_speeds.quote: The stage survey data were taken at 80, 90, 100, 110, and 120 percent of design speed.

z_reference.quote: Z axial distance references from rotor blade hub leading edge, cm

aero_chord_definition.value: straight line between blade leading and trailing edges along design streamline
aero_chord_definition.quote: AERO CHORD straight line between blade leading and trailing edges along design streamline, cm

percent_span_definition.value: percent of blade span from tip at rotor outlet
percent_span_definition.quote: PERCENT SPAN percent of blade span from tip at rotor outlet

angle_convention_beta.value: air angle between air velocity and axial direction
angle_convention_beta.quote: β air angle, angle between air velocity and axial direction, deg

angle_convention_kappa.value: angle between blade mean camber line and meridional plane
angle_convention_kappa.quote: κ angle between the blade mean camber line and the meridional plane, deg

setting_angle_definition.value: angle between aerodynamic chord and meridional plane
setting_angle_definition.quote: SETTING ANGLE angle between aerodynamic chord and meridional plane, deg

standard_conditions_cp_gamma.quote: C specific heat at constant pressure, 1004J/(kg)(K) ... ratio of specific heats (1.40) ... standard temperature of 288.2 K
